_about: Test case file database for the Endpoint DLP Test Plan. One entry per workbook row. verify.py checks every row's id AND name against the content modules, so a renumber that moves a test to a new ID fails the build until this file is reviewed. See ../TEST-DATA-REVIEW.md. readme_requirements holds data that a Read Me instruction needs but no row does; verify.py checks the instruction still exists in build.py.
